## Section 05: Developer & Tech Tools (/developer-tech-tools)
- Ollama (https://ollama.com): Get up and running with Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, and local LLMs. [open-source] [API Available] [Tags: #local-llm, #cli, #devtools]
- Cursor (https://cursor.com): AI-first code editor built for pair programming and rapid iteration. [freemium] [Tags: #ide, #code-assistant, #editor]
- v0 by Vercel (https://v0.dev): Generative UI system producing React components from text prompts. [freemium] [Tags: #frontend, #react, #ui-generation]
- vLLM (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm): High-throughput and memory-efficient LLM serving engine. [open-source] [API Available] [Tags: #llm-serving, #python, #inference]
- Code Assistants
- DevTools
- API Tools
- No-Code Builders
- AI Extensions

## Public Developer API Endpoints
- GET https://crawlers.dpdns.org/api/tools (Returns full JSON payload of all tools & tags)
- GET https://crawlers.dpdns.org/sitemap.xml (Full XML index of all dynamic paths)
- GET https://crawlers.dpdns.org/changelog/feed.json (JSON Feed for AI update monitoring)
- GET https://crawlers.dpdns.org/changelog/rss.xml (RSS Feed for release updates)
